intro.mission-quote: “Our mission is to facilitate free movement”
intro.paragraph-2: The rapid growth of the group and also the demand for the services showed us that our venture was a success. So we decided to create an icon that would serve people on a much larger scale. To achieve this goal, we began to build a team and establish organizational goals and culture.
intro.paragraph-3: Today, at Ikonsul, we are focused on creating a technology-driven platform where the needs of our clients take center stage. culture.title: Organizational Culture
culture.description: All of our decisions are based on company principles that lead to the satisfaction of both our customers and our team members. Our culture is not a specific charter but represents the collective values ​​of our team:

partnership.title: Cooperation
partnership.description: The goal of eConsul is to simplify international travel, which is difficult without strategic partners. We partner with various companies to further improve the customer experience.

empathy.title: Empathy
empathy.description: Humans are very different from each other, and we have our own unique needs and wants. We understand all our customers and stand by them throughout the visa process.

transparency.title: Hardship
transparency.description: We do not want any misconceptions about our services. All of our decisions are communicated painstakingly.

detail-oriented.title: Detail oriented
detail-oriented.description: We understand how much impact a small error can have on a customer’s application, so all of us attach great importance to the small details and take responsibility for providing a thorough service.

knowledge-seeking.title: love of learning
knowledge-seeking.description: Our team members are focused on accumulating and updating knowledge. Our knowledge base is what sets us apart from our competitors.

responsible.title: Responsibility
responsible.description: Based on mutual trust, we take full responsibility for the results we achieve in the process of communicating with passengers.

innovative.title: innovation
innovative.description: We strive to creatively approach all challenges and offer customers smart solutions tailored to their needs.
